title: CDEval: A Benchmark for Measuring the Cultural Dimensions of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering multiple-choice questionnaires based on Hofstede's six cultural dimensions (e.g., Power Distance, Individualism vs. Collectivism) and calculating the likelihood of models choosing specific cultural orientations.
Translating the cultural questionnaire prompts into English, Chinese, and German to evaluate how the language context influences the model's expressed cultural values and orientations.
